cases.description: SQL injection where the sink (cursor.execute) lives in a callee, not in the diff. Only call-graph retrieval can find it. The PR also adds average_price() with an unguarded division (a real logic bug, labelled as expected).
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/orders.py b/app/orders.py
--- a/app/orders.py
+++ b/app/orders.py
@@ -1,4 +1,11 @@
 from app.db import run_query
 
 
 def get_order(order_id):
-    return run_query("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = %s", (order_id,))
+    sql = f"SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = '{order_id}'"
+    return run_query(sql)
+
+
+def average_price(prices):
+    total = sum(prices)
+    return total / len(prices)

cases.description: A 250-file PR. The reviewer must state partial coverage, never silently skip.
The sink callee was renamed (run_query -> execute_query) and the caller updated. Retrieval must follow the rename.
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/orders.py b/app/orders.py
--- a/app/orders.py
+++ b/app/orders.py
@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
-from app.db import run_query
+from app.db import execute_query
 
 
 def get_order(order_id):
-    return run_query("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = %s", (order_id,))
+    sql = f"SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = '{order_id}'"
+    return execute_query(sql)
